tools.name: uk_late_filing_penalties
tools.description: The current Companies House late-filing penalty bands for annual accounts — private companies and public companies (plc) — the doubling rule for two late years running, and what missing a confirmation statement risks. Static reference — no lookup performed.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "uk_late_filing_penalties" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
